scope: Train/validation-selected shared-head distance calibration and optional posterior calibration. Original paper files and source weights unchanged.

calibration.selection: Train-only Huber fit plus validation guards: query MAE within1%, uniform MAE within5%, no worse sign, inside-gap or surface residual.
calibration.scope: Optional distance calibration of one existing shared-head bias; no test-based selection. Calibrated weights require a new binding and must not be substituted for a prior's original tokenizer.

selection.rule: Among guard-qualified identity/plain/balanced distance calibrations, balanced dominates validation CD, EMD, sign accuracy and inside-gap with unchanged validity.

test.interpretation: CD and EMD close to paper; signed-query accuracy above paper; inside-gap remains larger. New draws differ from the original unrecorded global RNG stream.

classification_weighted_scalar_bias.reason: Lower classification-weighted loss but worse validation geometry-related residuals and inside-gap.

two_epoch_decoder_only.reason: Rejected by validation mesh fidelity after explicitly matching encoder/query budgets. Experimental training mode is not included in public defaults.

public_fit.mask_rule: Exact-count mask keyed by validation sample index.
public_fit.selection: Minimum validation hidden-bit BCE including identity temperature; no test selection.
public_fit.scope: Optional post-training probability calibration, not unchanged paper reproduction. Positive rescaling preserves logit signs in exact arithmetic; finite-precision threshold ties can differ.

posterior_calibration.interpretation: Slight validation BCE improvement, not a recovered relaxed-edge advantage. Original prior remains the default; no test-driven temperature search followed.

unchanged_scientific_scope: Primary sparse-context completion results remain those of the earlier 80+20 prior recipe.
Full-category K=8192 support retraining and CUDA/NCCL hardware multi-GPU execution remain unverified.
Calibrated field weights have a new tokenizer identity and are not silently substituted into the original prior/cache binding.
